concerns.text: The Constitution Check table lists a row for “V. Versioning Discipline” but the plan’s description says “All output artifacts will be hashed and stored … automatically by the platform.” This wording does not explicitly state that a single source of truth (SSoT) file is designated for version hashes, which is required by Principle I of the constitution.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase Mapping to Functional Requirements & Success Criteria table
concerns.text: The plan refers to a contract file `contracts/results.schema.yaml` and an output file `results/validation_summary.csv`, but the data‑model defines `contracts/validation_results.schema.yaml` and expects a `validation_results.csv` (or similar). The mismatched contract name and output filename break the plan ↔ data‑model consistency.
